description: This file contains end-to-end tests for managing CPA (Custom Profile Attribute) fields in Mattermost, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting CPA fields via CLI commands.

classes.name: MmctlE2ETestSuite
classes.description: Test suite struct for end-to-end testing of CPA field commands in Mattermost.

methods.name: cleanCPAFields
methods.description: Removes all existing CPA fields to ensure a clean test state.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldListCmd
methods.description: Tests listing CPA fields with no entries and with existing entries.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldCreateCmd
methods.description: Tests creating CPA fields with different types and options.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldEditCmd
methods.description: Tests editing CPA fields, including by ID and by name, with various flags and options.

methods.name: TestCPAFieldDeleteCmd
methods.description: Tests deleting CPA fields by ID and name, including handling of nonexistent fields.
